title: In Vitro and In Vivo Biocompatibility Analysis of a New Transparent Collagen-based Wound Membrane for Tissue Regeneration in Different Clinical Indications
authors: Jung O, Radenkovic M, Stojanović S, Lindner C, Batinic M, Görke O, Pissarek J, Pröhl A, Najman S, Barbeck M. In Vivo. 2020 Sep-Oct;34(5):2287-2295. doi: 10.21873/invivo.12040.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The newly transparent collagen membrane is fully biocompatible and is supporting safe clinical application in tissue repair and surgery” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
